name: everest-inventory-reservation
description: Inventory reservation system that prevents overselling under high concurrency

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inventory/shared && npm run build -w @inventory/server && npm run build -w @inventory/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @inventory/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && npm run typecheck -w @inventory/server && npm run typecheck -w @inventory/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
